trust.title: Designed around farmer choice and privacy
trust.point1: Public browsing does not require personal data.
trust.point2: Personalised services begin only after login and purpose-specific consent.
trust.point3: All people, records, prices and operational values in this prototype are fictional.
trust.point4: Core journeys support English, Marathi, Hindi and Kannada.

footer.privacyBody1: KrishiSetu is a citizen-centred agricultural digital public infrastructure prototype.
footer.privacyBody2: Public browsing requires no login or personal information. Personalised services begin only after explicit consent.
footer.accessibilityBody1: KrishiSetu follows the UX4G, GIGW and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility baseline.
footer.accessibilityBody2: The experience includes large touch targets, strong contrast, keyboard access and multilingual support.
footer.sourcesBody: All market prices, weather conditions, notices and scheme parameters on this landing page are deterministic synthetic demonstration data.
